verses.text: Humble those who are happy about my troubles/difficulties, and cause them to be disgraced/ashamed.
I hope/desire that you will cause them to become dismayed and ashamed
But I hope/desire that all those who go to worship you will be very joyful [DOU].
As for me, I am poor and needy [DOU];
